text: {"lessons":["Evaluate each holding using its outlook and valuation, not its gain or loss versus my cost; a losing position is not automatically a sell, and a winner is not automatically a hold.","Avoid large, reactive reallocations based on short-term price moves; trade deliberately and keep decisions consistent with a long-term plan.","Before adding to a stock, check cash and portfolio concentration so I do not chase rising prices or take more risk than intended."]}
